Decisive refutation: already at m=3, naive_sum/I = 1.4132438198... > Dseq/I = 1.3405670816.... Hence summing all one-bit co-sensitivity divergences is not a valid lower bound on the sequential KL saving. The overcount factor grows on this family, while the valid adaptive one-bit bound remains below Dseq as required.
